class: Application-entry navigation conflicts with final-submit containment
symptom: Apply Now on a posting was intercepted as final submission before the application opened.
root_cause: The shared submit vocabulary intentionally includes Apply Now, while navigation attempted a normal click on that label. Social destinations could also be concealed behind generic link labels.
why_tests_missed: Guard tests exercised final controls and navigation tests used unguarded browsers; the intersection of a guarded posting and real application-entry link was missing.
fix: Follow a verified posting anchor with HTTP GET without dispatching click handlers or relaxing the guard. Keep buttons, fragment links and final submission guarded; reject social/job-board destinations by centralized sourcing policy.
prevention: Test entry navigation with the production submission guard enabled and with hostile click handlers. Never add a generic click exemption for Apply labels.
